facts.text: Bachelor of Science, Electrical and Computer Engineering, The University of Texas at Austin, December 2018.
Primary focus: Computer Architecture and Embedded Systems. Secondary focus: Integrated Circuits.

Relevant coursework and laboratories included Embedded Systems Design, Embedded and Real-Time Operating Systems, Computer Architecture, Digital Systems Design Using HDL, Algorithms, Software Design and Implementation, and Digital Logic Design.

notes: The full degree wording supersedes the historical shorter Computer Engineering wording. Focus areas are not additional degrees or formal minors. No GPA, graduate degree or professional certification is documented.
